title: The name that is not hers
priorStoryState: Sera Voss is alone in her quarters. Her Tallybone is on the desk. A Death Debt from a woman who died holding a Dying Candle has surfaced while she writes. The journal exists because centuries of inherited memories have made her own childhood indistinguishable from the dead. She has not taken Lethe tonight; the mines are restricted. No one else is in the room.
brief: Write the beat of Sera at the journal. The inherited memory offers a name, a room, and the shadow-cast of the Dying Candle. She must choose whether to write that name over her own or strike the page. The choice has to leave a mark on the journal that she will see tomorrow.
